title: Character card
summary: Use variables and print to build a card for a made-up game character.
prompt: Make a character card for Pip, a made-up game character. Store every fact in its own variable, then print the card exactly as shown below. Pip trains during the game, so the level changes from 3 to 4 before the last part of the card.
output:
=== CHARACTER CARD ===
Name: Pip
Role: Explorer
Home: Cloud Harbor
Level: 3
Favorite food: dumplings
Pet: Nib
Motto: Keep walking
----------------------
Pip finished training!
Level: 4
Nib is proud of Pip
======================

steps.text: Make the variables: name, role, home, level, food, pet and motto. Text gets quotes, the level is a number.
Print the top border and one line per fact, using a label and the variable, like Name: Pip.
Print the dashed line, then change level to 4.
Print the training lines and the bottom border.
steps.hint: print(name, "finished training!") gives Pip finished training! because print adds the space

tests.name: prints the whole card
tests.stdout:
=== CHARACTER CARD ===
Name: Pip
Role: Explorer
Home: Cloud Harbor
Level: 3
Favorite food: dumplings
Pet: Nib
Motto: Keep walking
----------------------
Pip finished training!
Level: 4
Nib is proud of Pip
======================

tests.name: level ends at 4
tests.post: assert level == 4, 'level should hold the number 4 at the end'

tests.name: name holds Pip
tests.post: assert name == 'Pip', 'name should hold the text Pip'

tests.name: pet holds Nib
tests.post: assert pet == 'Nib', 'pet should hold the text Nib'
